detailed_description: Email Signature Generator helps you create professional email signatures for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, and other email clients. Enter your name, job title, company, phone number, email, website, and social media links. Choose from multiple design templates and customize colors. The tool generates both HTML (for rich formatting) and plain text versions of your signature, ready to copy and paste into your email settings.
usage_steps: Enter your name and job title
Copy HTML or plain text signature
usage_examples: Design a signature with social links

faqs.question: Which email clients work with the generated signature?
faqs.answer: The HTML signature works in Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, Thunderbird, and most clients that accept rich HTML signatures. The plain text version covers text-only clients.

faqs.question: How do I add the signature to Gmail or Outlook?
faqs.answer: Copy the HTML version, then paste it into your email client's signature settings (Gmail: Settings > Signature; Outlook: Signature options). The formatting is preserved on paste.

faqs.question: Are the design templates customizable?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can choose from multiple templates and customize accent colors to match your brand.

faqs.question: Is my contact information stored anywhere?
faqs.answer: No. The signature is generated locally in your browser, and your details never leave the page.
